tests.name: Masquerading: Right-to-Left Override Batch File Creation and Execution
tests.description: 'Creates a batch file and then uses the RTLO operator (0x202E) to transform the file name from "evil_batchfdp.bat" to "evil_batchtab.pdf". The script then executes the batch file which displays "Hello World!" for 30 seconds before closing out.'

tests.name: Masquerading: RTLO Masqueraded File Download and Execution
tests.description: Downloads a batch file that has an obfuscated name utilizing the RTLO operator. The batch file then runs automatically, opening a cmd window and then closing 30 seconds later
